# OracleNep Security Research

> OracleNep researches application and AI agent security, builds security tools, and contributes to open-source projects. Public content uses the OracleNep alias.

## Public research and contributions

- NocoDB GHSA-hjgf-2f3h-4962: https://github.com/nocodb/nocodb/security/advisories/GHSA-hjgf-2f3h-4962
  Published 2026-11-02. High severity, CVSS 8.5. OracleNep is credited as reporter. Follow the advisory for remediation details.
- DeepSeek Harness public research report: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/853
  Control-plane authentication and trust-boundary research on 0.1.0-rc.6. A public discussion, not a published GHSA.
- VulnClaw solve-frontier recovery, merged: https://github.com/Netw0rkNoob/VulnClaw/pull/75
- PHP ext/intl documentation and test-comment maintenance, merged: https://github.com/php/php-src/pull/22261
- PHP request_parse_body / max_input_vars behavior, open for review: https://github.com/php/php-src/pull/22223

## Disclosure status

As of 2026-11-14, one private Flowise advisory is in draft and three Strapi reports are in triage. Their technical details are not published here. Do not describe these submissions as published advisories or assigned CVEs.

## Current focus

- Java / Spring source review, route and permission context, and root-cause analysis
- Semgrep / CodeQL SARIF import, finding review, and report generation
- Agent / MCP tool permissions, local control planes, and approval boundaries
- Reproducible verification, remediation review, and retesting

JavaSecAtlas is an audit-assistance workbench, not an automatic exploit-confirmation system. AgentFlowDesk v0.1.0 is a CLI; a web task board is not an implemented feature. Team projects and upstream contributions are identified separately on the portfolio.
